arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && for seed in 21 22 23 24; do python3 fuzz_plan.py $seed 40 & done; wait; echo "=== perf ==="; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
for name, log in (('heavy2 (valid, distinct)', 't/heavy2.jsonl'),
                  ('heavy (mostly invalid)', 't/heavy_log.jsonl'),
                  ('dup-heavy', 't/dup_log.jsonl'),
                  ('all-distinct', 't/dist_log.jsonl')):
    t0 = time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py',
                        'replay', 't/max_manifest.json', log],
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    wall = time.time() - t0
    u = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    out = json.loads(r.stdout)
    print('%-26s exit=%d wall=%.2fs rss=%dMiB accepted=%d dup=%d diag=%d' % (
        name, r.returncode, wall, u.ru_maxrss//1024, out['accepted_rows'],
        out['duplicate_rows'], len(out['diagnostics'])))
t0 = time.time()
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/submission/ipv6_replay.py',
                   'plan', 't/max_manifest.json'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print('plan max                   exit=%d wall=%.2fs outbytes=%d' % (r.returncode, time.time()-t0, len(r.stdout)))
EOF
